objective: Measure whether the two layer-63 candidate experts that independently improved model KLD in both frozen eight-document groups retain their gain when enabled together.
evidence_boundary: Experts 149 and 164 were selected with all 16 public 512-token documents. Their composition is another candidate-selection measurement on those documents. It requires confirmation on a new document-disjoint reference tier even if it improves every reported selection statistic.

selection_protocol.retention_rule: Retain the composition only when candidate-minus-resident equal-document mean KLD is negative in both document groups.
selection_protocol.composition_boundary: A retained composition is frozen without further expert changes before a new document-disjoint confirmation tier is opened.

candidate_arms.name: experts-149-and-164
candidate_arms.reason: Both singleton candidates improved equal-document mean KLD in the first eight and the remaining eight public documents. Measuring the pair tests non-additive model effects.
